summary: Restore production login after the V0.19.6 frontend bundle omitted its Supabase build configuration, and add release gates that prevent the same invalid artifact from being deployed again.

notes: No database schema or data changes are included in this release.
Supabase, PostgreSQL, GoTrue, PostgREST, and Realtime remained healthy; the incident was isolated to the static frontend bundle.
Rebuilds the production frontend with VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY present so login requests reach GoTrue.
Adds a Playwright regression that submits an invalid probe login and proves the browser reaches the authentication endpoint instead of failing on missing Supabase runtime configuration.
Adds a pre-image frontend artifact gate that verifies the production anon key is embedded and rejects unresolved placeholders.
Adds a post-deploy container gate that verifies the running static bundle contains the expected Supabase configuration without printing the key.

verification: Run git diff --check, frontend lint, unit tests, and production build.
Run deploy/scripts/verify-frontend-build-config.sh against the staged production frontend dist before building the app image.
Run deploy/scripts/pre-deploy-check.sh with EXPECTED_VERSION=V0.19.7 after deployment.
Run the production Playwright login runtime-config regression and confirm the authentication request returns an expected invalid-credential response.
